it.title: Senet
it.description: Una versione elettronica online del Senet, antenato del Backgammon e simile al Gioco Reale di Ur, con due set di regole (CEMEA e Kendall & Bell)

en.title: Senet
en.description: An online version of Senet, an ancestor of Backgammon and similar to the Royal Game of Ur, with two rule sets (CEMEA and Kendall & Bell).

it.title: Wari
it.description: Una versione elettronica online del Wari, il più diffuso dei mancala, con due set di regole (Abapa e Caraibi), tre livelli di gioco e strategia avanzata

en.title: Wari
en.description: An online version of Wari, the most widespread mancala game, with two rule sets (Abapa and Caribbean), three difficulty levels, and advanced strategy.

en.title: Royal Game of Ur
en.description: An online electronic version of the Royal Game of Ur, an ancestor of Backgammon, featuring two rule sets (Finkel and Bell).
An online electronic version of Tablut, with Linnean rules (retranslated)

it.description: Un assistente vocale per il posizionamento delle levette dell'arpa celtica in funzione della tonalità. Per non vedenti. Testato per Android. ***NON FUNZIONA SOTTO WINDOWS*** Solo in italiano.

en.description: A voice assistant for positioning the levers on a Celtic harp according to the key. For the visually impaired. Tested on Android. ***DOES NOT WORK ON WINDOWS*** Available only in Italian.

An accessible vocal tuner for the blind and visually impaired. It features a large, high-contrast gauge and note indicator, as well as a voice output that reads the notes aloud, indicating whether they are low or high—a useful feature for the blind. Only available in Italian
A simple app for rolling dice. It responds to voice commands and announces the results using text-to-speech. It does NOT work on Windows. Tested on Android and iPhone. Only available in Italian

it.title: Levette Arpa Celtica
it.description: Una guida per l'impostazione delle levette delle arpe celtiche: scegli la tonalità, scopri quali levette muovere.
